$comment: Taiga fork defaults. The editor base locale is patched in src/lib/i18n/locales.ts (DEFAULT_BASE_LOCALE = 'ja'). This file records the rest of the house defaults so scripts and agents share one source of truth.

storage.note: Projects stay on the device by default. Cloud save, live collaboration and store uploads are opt in per project, never on by default.

templateStyleNote: Pick the base style per app: taiga-md3 for Material Design 3 apps, taiga-glass for Simple Glass apps. Layout and copy are identical, only the visual base differs.
